narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with low pressure moving along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of the Lower Maryland Eastern Shore.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Brittingham and Hammond Streets just northeast of Salisbury.
Vehicle was stuck in high water east of Downtown Salisbury.
Car was stuck in high water in the 1900 Block of Salisbury Boulevard.
Car was stuck in high water near the intersection of Kiley Drive and Zion Road.
Street and road flooding were reported. Road was closed due to flooding. Vehicles were stranded.
